title: Container Bookings: Containers on Which Roll Compensation Is Paid
content:
Roll compensation on a Container Bookings booking is paid per container, and only on containers that the line was actually going to carry.

## Rule

Where the line has turned down one of the booking's dangerous-goods acceptances, the containers named on it were never going to sail, and they earn no compensation. The containers compensated are the booking's container quantity diminished by the rejected acceptance's container count, and the figure cannot drop below zero. Where there is no rejected acceptance on the booking, nothing is deducted.

Where two or more of the booking's acceptances stand rejected, these compensation rules give no container figure, and such a booking lies beyond them.

## Hypothetical cases

| Booking quantity | Rejected dangerous-goods acceptance | Containers compensated |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | none | 8 |
| 8 | covering 2 containers | 6 |
| 3 | covering 4 containers | 0 |
| 8 | acceptance approved, none rejected | 8 |

The booking quantity comes from the booking record and the acceptance status and container count from the dangerous-goods acceptance records. The quantities shown are invented.
